title: Scaling DGK-alpha Drug Discovery through GPU-Accelerated Virtual Screening and Ensemble Molecular Dynamics
summary: Uses fast computer screening to find drug candidates against a protein that helps glioblastoma, a deadly brain cancer, grow and hide from the immune system.

title: Harness Human Gut Microbial MAIT Boosters to Enhance MAIT cell Antitumor Immunity Against Liver Cancer
summary: Tests whether helpful gut bacteria can power up immune cells in the liver to fight liver cancer.

title: Virtual Spatial Transcriptomics Enables Large-Scale Multimodal Analysis of Glioblastoma
summary: Uses AI to read thousands of existing brain-tumor slides as if they had costly gene maps, to learn how glioblastoma varies inside each tumor.

title: Environmental Programming of Ovarian Aging Across Generations: Spaceflight as a Model
summary: Studies the daughters and granddaughters of mice that flew in space to learn how the environment can speed up reproductive aging across generations.

title: ReproImmuneAge: Mapping Immune Aging from Routine Histology in the Human Ovary
summary: Builds a way to tell from routine tissue slides whether an ovary is aging faster or slower than a woman's age suggests.

title: GeoAge: LLM-Powered Metadata Curation and Mega Meta-Analysis of the Human Aging Transcriptome
summary: Uses AI to organize thousands of public human gene datasets into the largest study yet of how our genes change with age.

title: Region-Specific Proteostasis Remodeling Shapes Motility Decline in the Aging Gut
summary: Investigates why the gut slows down with age, a common cause of constipation in older adults.

title: scPerturbClock: Genome-scale Causal Discovery of Aging Regulators with Machine Learning
summary: Uses machine learning on large gene-editing experiments to find the genes that drive aging, not just change with it.

title: Identifying exposome drivers of age-associated low-grade inflammation
summary: Uses data from 50,000 UK Biobank participants to find which lifestyle and environmental factors cause the chronic inflammation that comes with age.

title: The Lonely Brain Ages Faster
summary: Uses brain scans of 725 older adults to test whether loneliness makes the brain age faster, and why.

title: Capillary Microperfusion Across the Alzheimer’s Continuum: Extracting IVIM Perfusion from Multi-Shell Diffusion MRI in ADNI
summary: Pulls a hidden measure of blood flow in the brain's tiniest vessels out of existing scans to see how it changes on the path to Alzheimer's.

title: Can Deep Learning Unlock Hidden Perfusion Information from Existing Brain MRI Scans?
summary: Tests whether deep learning can recover blood-flow information from brain MRIs thousands of people have already had, to speed up Alzheimer's research.

title: Alzheimer disease Project
summary: Sets out a theory of how Alzheimer's disease develops and a proposed therapy to slow it.

title: Drugging the “Hard Problem” with General Anesthetics
summary: Uses anesthesia drugs, which switch consciousness off and back on, to study how the brain creates conscious experience.

title: In Vivo Neuroimaging of Glymphatic Function in Autism Spectrum Disorder: Completing a Multi-Modal, Open-Data Biotyping Pilot
summary: Images the brain's waste-clearing system in autism, looking for a biological reason autism varies so much from person to person.

title: We Know Inflammation Damages the Brain. Nobody Has Actually Mapped How.
summary: Maps which inflammation signals in the blood reach and harm the brain, by studying people with autoimmune diseases.

title: The Most Overlooked Nootropic: A Body-Brain-Blood Investigation of Metformin’s Cognitive Enhancement Potential
summary: Tests whether metformin, a cheap and common diabetes drug, can also sharpen thinking and memory.

title: A Parallel 3D-MEA Closed-Loop Chemogenetic Platform to Restore Network Computation in Disease-Modeled Assembloids
summary: Builds a lab platform to record and stimulate mini brain tissues grown from patients' cells, to see how disease disrupts brain networks.

title: Network Analysis of Neural Subsystems to Assess Consciousness, Cognition, and Ethical Implications
summary: Develops ways to measure how complex lab-grown brain tissue becomes, to guide the ethics of this research.

title: Decisive Times - Intrinsic Timescales & Decoding Stability
summary: Uses public brain recordings to study how the timing of brain activity keeps our decisions steady.

title: AromaPen: A Portable Scent-Memory Device for Enhanced Academic Performance
summary: Tests whether a pen that releases the same scent while studying and during exams helps students remember more.

title: Identifying Interventions to Reduce Acute Stress and Prevent PTSD
summary: Searches for treatments that ease acute stress after trauma and keep it from turning into PTSD in service members.

title: Defining Endogenous DMT Brain Biotypes: A Multi-Modal Neuroimaging Study
summary: Images the brains of 1,100 people to study DMT, a compound the body makes itself, and its links to depression and anxiety.

title: Pilot screening of structure-guided small-molecule inhibitors targeting filovirus nucleocapsid assembly
summary: Screens new drug candidates that could stop Ebola and Marburg viruses from assembling inside our cells.

title: Restoring Mitochondrial Fitness to Enhance Antiviral Immunity in Treated HIV Infection: A Host-Directed Therapeutic Strategy
summary: Tests whether restoring cells' energy factories can strengthen immunity in people living with HIV.

title: Experimental Validation of Structure-Guided Small-Molecule Inhibitors of TIM-1-Mediated Viral Entry
summary: Tests 97 drug candidates that may block a doorway many emerging viruses use to get into our cells.

title: Development of a Phage-based Delivery Platform for Antiviral Peptides targeting Intracellular Viral Proteins
summary: Turns harmless bacteria-infecting viruses into carriers that deliver antiviral drugs inside lung cells.

title: Role of C3, C4b, CXCL10 and LCN2 in HIV associated white matter injury
summary: Studies four inflammatory molecules that may cause the brain damage seen in many people with HIV.

title: Meta-Learning Framework for Predicting Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR) in Staphylococcus aureus
summary: Uses machine learning to predict when staph bacteria have become resistant to antibiotics.

title: A Plant-Based Diet to Improve Vascular Function and Atherosclerosis-Related Biomarkers in Coronary Artery Disease (CAD): Mechanistic Insights from Redox-Inflammation Multi-Omics
summary: Tests whether a plant-based diet can improve blood-vessel health in people with coronary artery disease.

title: NAD+ Supplementation Strengthens the Thoracic Aorta by Modulating YAP/SOX9-dependent Mechanotransduction and Extracellular Matrix Remodeling
summary: Tests whether boosting NAD+, a molecule that falls with age, can strengthen the aorta and help prevent deadly aneurysms.

title: The Right Diet Is in Your DNA: Identifying Biomarkers for Personalized Weight Loss
summary: Looks for markers in your genes that predict whether a low-carb or a low-fat diet will help you lose weight.

title: Interpretable AI for Ultrasound-Based Assessment of Immune-Mediated Intestinal Inflammation in Crohn’s Disease
summary: Builds AI that reads ultrasound scans to track gut inflammation in Crohn's disease without invasive tests.

title: Assessment of unregulated drinking water risks in U.S. tap water using non-targeted Total Organic Halogen (TOX) analysis
summary: Tests tap water across all 18 major U.S. river basins for chemicals that drinking-water rules don't yet cover.

title: Comparing Low Frequency Electromagnetic Fields Around NFL Football Stadiums Versus Everyday Exposure
summary: Measures electromagnetic fields around NFL stadiums to see how they compare with what people meet every day.

title: Determining the influence of ELF-EMFs on anabolic/catabolic remodeling using bioengineered tissue models
summary: Uses lab-grown tissue to test whether everyday electromagnetic fields weaken tendons and muscles.

title: Evaluation of voltage gated calcium channel activity as a mechanism for ELF-EMF induced tendon injury susceptibility
summary: Tests whether long-term exposure to electromagnetic fields makes tendons more prone to injury.

title: Chronic Low-Frequency Electromagnetic Field Exposure as a Modifier of Ligament Injury Susceptibility and Early Post-Injury Inflammation
summary: Tests whether electromagnetic fields make ligaments more likely to tear and slower to heal.

title: Untargeted Metabolomics, Antioxidant Capacity, and Total Phenolic Content of Honey produced by Apis mellifera in Guam and Okinawa
summary: Analyzes the chemistry and antioxidants of honey made by bees in Guam and Okinawa.

title: Self-Validating Spectral Decoding for Ultra-Low-Rate Neutrino Communication
summary: Adapts methods from brain imaging to make messages sent through the Earth on neutrino beams faster and more reliable.

title: Two-Color-Gated Optogenetics: Working Towards Full Spatiotemporal Control of Gene Expression in 3D Cellular Architectures
summary: Builds a light-controlled switch that turns genes on only where two beams of light cross, for precise control in 3D tissue.

title: PainPaw: A Mobile Application for Standardized Behavioral Pain Testing in Rodents
summary: Builds a free phone app that standardizes common pain tests in lab research and cuts recording errors.
